season.evidence: The couloir needs snow; SummitPost says most people climb late June to October, and a late-June 2024 Oregon Hikers report found the snow manageable. Logged ascents run Jun-Sep. Snow route best Jun to early Jul, ridge walk later.

missing.overview: Reach Tenderfoot Pass by the East Fork Wallowa trail, then follow the short, steeper north arm of the summit horseshoe on a faint path with a few hands-on steps. The longer, gentler south arm is an alternative.
evidence: https://www.summitpost.org/petes-point/153193 - two easy walk-up arms from Tenderfoot Pass, north arm steeper, rock step near 9,500 ft

notes: Our stored route is the north-face snow couloir; the harvested ascents are ridge walk-ups, which the stored text does not describe, so none is assigned. No trailhead pin is stored; no trailhead coordinate was fetched, so none is proposed.
